newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent crude ends day slightly lower pre API's.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent crude ends day slightly lower pre API's.

text.p: June IPE Brent ended the day just a few cents lower on Tuesday as the expected retracement failed to happen. Brokers said many locals had taken short postions early in the day but bought back as the early downward move failed to hold its momentum.
"Everyone expected a retracement so the market went lower early but there was no momentum and they lost their bottle and covered themselves. No-body wanted to be short before the API's," one said.
June Brent ended Tuesday down some nine cents at $19.63, well off the day's low of $19.44 a barrel. The contract, which expires on Thursday, gained almost 80 cents on Monday.

The weekly U.S. stock figures from the API are due out after markets close on Tuesday. Preliminary trader estimates for the week ended May 9 were for a crude build of 0.75 million barrels, a build on distillates of 2.2 million barrels and an increase in gasoline stocks of one million barrels.
"But when you see the market recovering like it just has on a Tuesday night it looks like someone is taking a punt on bullish API's," another broker said.

A fire at a 132,500 barrel per day Citgo refinery in the U.S. gave gasoline on ACCESS an early boost. But testing prior to the restart of Tosco Corp's Pennsylvanian refinery later dampened enthusiasm and levels on crudes and products fell off.
The Tosco plant is expected to add about 100,000 bpd to the Atlantic basin gasoline market.
June gas oil closed earlier down 50 cents at $173.25 a tonne
